description: The platform's AI plane end to end: the agent runtime's reasoning loop, the models and tokens behind it, the seven MCP domain servers it calls tools through, the agentgateway data plane that enforces identity and guardrails, and k8sgpt's findings. Every query is built on metrics verified present on a live cluster. Filed under the AI folder; the platform front page is Adhar Platform.
